balderton-graphcore:greenhouse:853716000.title: Electronics Lab Technician
balderton-graphcore:greenhouse:853716000.description:
About us

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.

 

Job Summary

As an Electronics Laboratory Technician, you will support the day-to-day operation of Graphcore’s Bristol laboratories, helping to ensure that facilities, equipment, tools and processes are ready to support engineering activity. Working as part of the Laboratory team, you will help maintain a safe, organised and reliable electronics lab environment, supporting cross-functional teams with equipment setup, preventative maintenance, asset control, ESD checks and technical documentation.

 

The Team

The Laboratory team supports the installation, maintenance, repair and modification of electronic systems, cables and equipment within Graphcore’s laboratories. The team works closely with engineering groups to help set up test benches, troubleshoot routine lab issues and ensure that equipment is safe, available and operating reliably. The team also maintains technical documentation, manages tools, assets and test equipment, and contributes to efficient, high-quality laboratory operations.

 

Responsibilities and Duties

· Support the installation, setup and calibration of electronic test equipment, including oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power supplies and related laboratory equipment.
· Carry out preventative maintenance activities to help keep laboratory equipment available, safe and reliable.
· Maintain a clean, organised and safe laboratory environment in line with health and safety requirements.
· Check and maintain ESD countermeasures, escalating issues where corrective action is required.
· Support asset management activities, including tracking tools, equipment and laboratory assets.
· Manage goods in/out processes for laboratory equipment, components and related materials.
· Support engineering teams with test bench setup, equipment configuration and technical readiness for hardware bring-up, validation and characterisation activities.
· Help create and maintain standard operating procedures, work instructions and technical guidance for laboratory users.
· Provide practical support to laboratory users, including guidance on safe equipment use and routine lab processes.
· Support engineering teams with board, cable and wire modifications, following agreed procedures and quality expectations.
· Maintain accurate records for equipment, maintenance activity, assets and laboratory processes.
· Identify routine laboratory issues and work with colleagues to resolve or escalate them promptly.

 

Candidate Profile

Essential:

· Experience working in an electronics laboratory or similar technical environment.
· Strong practical understanding of electronic test equipment, including setup, calibration and basic troubleshooting.
· Awareness of ESD controls and safe working practices in an electronics lab environment.
· Ability to follow technical procedures accurately and maintain clear records.
· Practical experience supporting equipment maintenance, lab organisation or asset tracking.
· Good attention to detail, with a focus on quality, safety and reliability.
· Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and operations teams.
· A proactive and organised approach to managing tasks and supporting laboratory users.

Desirable

· Experience supporting hardware bring-up, validation or characterisation activities.
· Experience with soldering, rework, cable assembly or board-level modifications.
· Familiarity with calibration processes, asset management systems or goods in/out processes.
· Relevant technical qualification in electronics, electrical engineering or a related discipline.
· Experience working in a semiconductor, electronics, computing hardware or high-technology R&D environment.
· Familiarity with laboratory quality processes, equipment documentation or standard operating procedures.

balderton-lendable-co:ashbyhq:9c1b6ab5-5.description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

 3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



About the role

We'd love for you to become a key part of our Python Infrastructure team; a collaborative group that's always pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

In this role, you'll get to do it all: designing and integrating powerful new APIs that genuinely improve our customers' experience, optimising our lending platforms for performance and scale, and diving into the kind of deep architectural conversations that engineers get excited about.

No two days look the same here.

We're building something great, and we're looking for the right people to grow with us. If that sounds like you, we can't wait to hear from you.



Our Tech Stack

Our stack is built on Python and FastAPI, deployed via Docker and Kubernetes on AWS, with ArgoCD handling our continuous delivery pipeline.



What we’re looking for

 - Strong, modern Python development experience

 - A good understanding of a modern web framework - FastAPI

 - Strong automatic testing skills (unit, integration, functional)

 - A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team

 - If you’ve worked in a cross functional environment, it would be a plus but not needed
   
   

Interview process

 - A quick phone call with one of the team

 - A short coding exercise to complete in your own time

 - Technical Video Interview for 60 mins
   
   - Meet the team you’ll work with daily

 - Culture interview for 30mins

 - Final Interview




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

We’re looking for a Frontend Software Engineer, with strong Typescript and React/NextJS experience, to join our US loans team. This is a cross-functional team tasked with delivering new features and technical refinements on one of our fastest growing products, Unsecured Loans, tackling the toughest and most dynamic credit market in the world, the United States.



There’s lots to do, from building out new user journeys and optimising conversion rates in our existing funnels, and answering questions with experiments and fast iteration, to maintaining, refactoring & improving our codebase and tooling.



Our ideal engineer is proactive, product-oriented, detail focused and resourceful, keen to understand the bigger picture outside of their product team and working at pace, contributing to wider engineering and business initiatives that help us further scale our products as we continue to grow.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Essential:

 - 3+ years experience.

 - Reside in Europe or the UK

 - Strong knowledge of modern Javascript with Typescript and React.js

 - Commercial experience with the latest versions of NextJS.

 - Good understanding of automated testing in software development, and take a pragmatic approach to implementing and improving the various phases of the testing pyramid.

 - Able to identify and assess technical debt and are a vocal advocate for prioritising code improvements alongside feature work whenever the opportunity arises.

 - Solid understanding of the importance of catering to users with accessibility needs, and familiarity with approaches and tooling required to ensure accessibility guidelines and best practices are adhered to.

 - Proactive in taking ownership over your work and collaborating with product, ensuring progress by communicating blockers, seeking feedback, and driving tasks to completion.

 - Comfortable working with product owners and senior engineers to identify the difficulties of implementing a feature from an initial design wireframe or outline spec and are not afraid to put forward alternative approaches where you feel it appropriate.

Desirable:

 - Experience working at a Fintech or startup/scaleup environment.

 - Experience working on financial systems.

 - A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team.





WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU STAND OUT

 - You have experience working on multi-product web applications in a monorepo environment (we use Turborepo).

 - You have worked with modern React functionality such as Server Components, and the NextJS app folder, and have a good understanding of how you would approach a migration toward this new architecture.

 - You’ve worked with OpenAPI/Swagger specifications to help define API requirements and contracts, collaborating with backend developers to agree on best approaches when scoping work that requires new and updated schemas.

 - You have demonstrable experience with web performance best practices and debugging.

 - You’ve employed staged rollouts and multivariate testing approaches to release new features and test hypotheses

 - You have experience of UI or UX design. You feel at ease discussing design decisions with product managers and designers, and are happy to get involved in putting forward ideas when required
   
   


OUR TECH STACK

Web:

 - Typescript, React, NextJS, ﻿Redux Toolkit, SCSS Modules, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright, Turborepo

Backend / Infrastructure:

 - PHP 8 (Symfony), Kotlin, MySQL, RabbitMQ, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes

Tooling:

 - ArgoCD and Github Actions

 - Github, Jira & Confluence, for our code & product management processes

 - Datadog & Sentry, for debugging and reporting

 - Figma, for our design process
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - A quick video call with a member of our talent team to learn more about you

 - A Cognitive test - short 15 minute test to complete in your own time

 - A short coding exercise to complete in your own time

 - A technical interview with your peers where you’ll talk through some problems and scenarios, and dig deeper into your technical experience and knowledge

 - A culture add with an Engineering Manager to better understand your ways of working, assess how you could play a part in your team’s success, and get a good idea what we can do to help you thrive in your role.




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

jobDescription.description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

 3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



We’re looking for a Frontend Software Engineer, with strong Typescript and React/NextJS experience, to join our US loans team. This is a cross-functional team tasked with delivering new features and technical refinements on one of our fastest growing products, Unsecured Loans, tackling the toughest and most dynamic credit market in the world, the United States.



There’s lots to do, from building out new user journeys and optimising conversion rates in our existing funnels, and answering questions with experiments and fast iteration, to maintaining, refactoring & improving our codebase and tooling.



Our ideal engineer is proactive, product-oriented, detail focused and resourceful, keen to understand the bigger picture outside of their product team and working at pace, contributing to wider engineering and business initiatives that help us further scale our products as we continue to grow.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Essential:

 - 3+ years experience.

 - Reside in Europe or the UK

 - Strong knowledge of modern Javascript with Typescript and React.js

 - Commercial experience with the latest versions of NextJS.

 - Good understanding of automated testing in software development, and take a pragmatic approach to implementing and improving the various phases of the testing pyramid.

 - Able to identify and assess technical debt and are a vocal advocate for prioritising code improvements alongside feature work whenever the opportunity arises.

 - Solid understanding of the importance of catering to users with accessibility needs, and familiarity with approaches and tooling required to ensure accessibility guidelines and best practices are adhered to.

 - Proactive in taking ownership over your work and collaborating with product, ensuring progress by communicating blockers, seeking feedback, and driving tasks to completion.

 - Comfortable working with product owners and senior engineers to identify the difficulties of implementing a feature from an initial design wireframe or outline spec and are not afraid to put forward alternative approaches where you feel it appropriate.

Desirable:

 - Experience working at a Fintech or startup/scaleup environment.

 - Experience working on financial systems.

 - A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team.





WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU STAND OUT

 - You have experience working on multi-product web applications in a monorepo environment (we use Turborepo).

 - You have worked with modern React functionality such as Server Components, and the NextJS app folder, and have a good understanding of how you would approach a migration toward this new architecture.

 - You’ve worked with OpenAPI/Swagger specifications to help define API requirements and contracts, collaborating with backend developers to agree on best approaches when scoping work that requires new and updated schemas.

 - You have demonstrable experience with web performance best practices and debugging.

 - You’ve employed staged rollouts and multivariate testing approaches to release new features and test hypotheses

 - You have experience of UI or UX design. You feel at ease discussing design decisions with product managers and designers, and are happy to get involved in putting forward ideas when required
   
   


OUR TECH STACK

Web:

 - Typescript, React, NextJS, ﻿Redux Toolkit, SCSS Modules, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright, Turborepo

Backend / Infrastructure:

 - PHP 8 (Symfony), Kotlin, MySQL, RabbitMQ, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes

Tooling:

 - ArgoCD and Github Actions

 - Github, Jira & Confluence, for our code & product management processes

balderton-zego:workable:76497bb73c.title: FNOL Claims Handler
balderton-zego:workable:76497bb73c.description:
About Zego
At Zego, we understand that traditional motor insurance holds good drivers back. It's too complicated, too expensive, and it doesn't reflect how well you actually drive. Since 2016, we have been on a mission to change that by offering the lowest priced insurance for good drivers.
From van drivers and gig workers to everyday car drivers, our customers are the driving force behind everything we do. We've sold tens of millions of policies and raised over $200 million in funding and picked up numerous awards, including the Insurance Claims Team Of The Year 2024 as awarded at The Insurance Post's Claims & Fraud Awards. And we're only just getting started.
That's where you come in...
We're on the lookout for a passionate, driven, and eager FNOL Claims Handler to grow with our team in Halifax. This is a fantastic opportunity for individuals who may not have prior insurance experience but are eager to learn and thrive in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.
What you will be doing
You will be the first point of contact for customers at their most crucial moments, handling First Notification of Loss (FNOL) queries via phone, email and live chat, with empathy, accuracy, and efficiency.
You will capture all relevant claim details accurately at first point of contact, ensuring customers are triaged and routed to the right next step in their claims journey.
You will ensure that every customer interaction reflects Zego's commitment to exceptional service, leaving customers feeling heard, supported, and informed.
You will work collaboratively with our wider Claims team and supply chain partners to ensure seamless claim progression from the very first touchpoint.
You will maintain accurate records within our claims management systems, ensuring data quality at every stage.
What you will need to be successful
You bring a positive and proactive mindset, displaying enthusiasm for acquiring new knowledge and embracing challenges.
You have a natural ability to communicate with empathy and clarity, especially when customers are in distress.
You’re happy to work in a call centre environment, building rapport and supporting customers. 
You have an eye for detail and a flair for building rapport quickly over the phone.
You have the ability to multitask, set priorities, and manage time effectively in a high-volume contact centre environment.
We are looking for a dedicated and flexible individual to join our team. This position requires availability to work 37.5 hours per week. Our standard working hours include weekdays, evenings, and weekends, and you will be expected to work a 5 out of 7 days per week shift schedule.
This role requires shift working: 
Monday to Friday: 8am-4:40pm or 9:30am - 6pm 
Saturday is 8am-6pm
Sunday 10am-4pm
What's it like to work at Zego
Zego has a truly international and inclusive team, unified by great ideas and collaborative thoughtfulness. Our people are the most important part of our story and everyone plays an essential role in our journey. We look for people who have expertise, enthusiasm and who are motivated by change. There’s plenty of room to learn and grow, as part of our ongoing training programmes or directly from other experts. You’ll work alongside a talented group of people who respect each other's differences and seek to understand fresh perspectives.
How we work
We believe that teams work better when they have time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid.
Our hybrid way of working is unique. We foster a flexible approach that empowers every Zegon to perform at their best. You would be expected to be in our Halifax office once or twice per month. We will provide a hybrid contribution to help pay towards your travel costs and cover the costs for all company-wide events (3 per year).
We think it's a good mix of collaborative face time and flexible home-working, setting us up to achieve the right balance between work and life.
Our approach to AI
We believe in the power of AI to meaningfully improve how we work - helping us move faster, think differently, and focus on what matters most. At Zego, we encourage people to stay curious and intentional about how AI is leveraged in their work and teams to drive practical impact every day. This is your chance to do the most meaningful work of your career - and we’ll provide you with the tools, support, and freedom to do it well.
Benefits
We reward our people well. Join us and you'll get a market-competitive salary, private medical insurance, company share options, generous holiday allowance, and a whole lot of wellbeing benefits. And that's just for starters.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. If you need any support with your application please get in touch with us on people@zego.com

base10-brex:greenhouse:8152870002.title: Enterprise Implementation Consultant
base10-brex:greenhouse:8152870002.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Implementation at Brex 

Implementation transforms new customers into power users. We lead the onboarding experience for companies adopting Brex Empower, helping them shift from outdated processes to a modern, employee-first approach. It’s a role that blends customer empathy, project management, technical expertise, process design, and change management. We take personal ownership of our customers' long-term success, and we set customers up thoroughly so they can be with ‘Brex for life’. As strategic advisors, we build trust, drive solutions with tenacity, deliver results fast, and work cross-functionally to make adoption seamless for customers.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Implementation Consultant, you will serve as a strategic advisor to our largest customers, guiding them through a successful launch of the Brex platform. Acting as a hybrid coach, project manager, and product expert, your primary goals will be to drive wide product adoption, deliver ongoing business value, and help customers transform their financial workflows.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Lead and project manage end-to-end global enterprise implementations and launches. This includes scoping customer outcomes, creating project plans, mobilizing stakeholders, configuring and testing the platform, and overseeing accounting software integrations.
  • Serve as a strategic consultant by working closely with customers to discover their business needs, leading design workshops, and coaching them on how to best use Brex to solve their challenges.
  • Drive customer success and adoption by developing strategies to ramp up spending activity, and providing global change management planning to guide clients on their communication approach, training materials, and execution.
  • Manage and cultivate customer relationships by building multi-threaded connections from senior leaders to day-to-day stakeholders, managing expectations, and working diligently to provide solutions to any challenges.
  • Act as a key cross-functional partner within the Brex account team, collaborating with Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships to deliver a smooth customer experience and align on partner-led solutions.
  • Influence product development by adapting quickly to product changes, communicating them strategically to stakeholders, and providing a key voice into future iterations of the product roadmap.
  • Build and execute a prioritization strategy for managing multiple high-touch customer relationships effectively.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in customer-facing SaaS or consulting roles, including hands-on global project management or consulting work supporting complex, enterprise-level organizations.
  • A knack for leading complex customer engagements, with the ability to comfortably manage both technical and non-technical workstreams.
  • Exceptional communication and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to resolve issues cross-functionally and deliver creative, customized solutions for a variety of customers.
  • A proven track record of building customer-centric processes and a strong sense of urgency to drive projects to completion while achieving desired business outcomes.

Bonus points

  • Hands-on implementation experience with Financial, Expense Management, Travel & Expense, or ERP software.
  • Additional domain expertise in any of the following areas: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Procurement, or Corporate Card Program Management.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $145,544 - $181,930 USD.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

battery-braze:greenhouse:7871576.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As our customer base continues to grow with the excitement around BrazeAI, we’re expanding our team! Join our Forward-Deployed Data Scientist group of creative technical experts who partner with customers to ensure their success. In this role, you will:

  • Collaborate with customer Analytics/BI teams and Braze colleagues on implementations, including use case definition, data integration, pipeline setup, and ML model configuration
  • Extend product capabilities by improving architecture and developing reusable data pipelines, APIs, and components
  • Work closely with the RL pipeline development team to refine and advance our reinforcement learning (self-learning) algorithms
  • Contribute to shaping BrazeAI product strategy and roadmap through customer-facing insights and technical expertise
  • Provide ongoing technical expertise to ensure successful adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term customer success

WHO YOU ARE

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field required; Master’s or PhD in a relevant technical discipline preferred
  • Experience: 3–5+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, or similar role working with large-scale data and production environments. Experience in customer-facing or consulting roles is strongly preferred
  • Strong technical expertise: Proficient in Python (Pandas) and core ML libraries (TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn, CatBoost, XGBoost). Skilled in SQL for querying/manipulating datasets, with experience in machine learning pipelines and model deployment
  • Engineering best practices: You write well-structured, modular, documented code; follow strong development practices (Git, CI/CD, testing frameworks, type-hinting, code reviews); and can build scalable, maintainable solutions
  • Nice-to-have skills: Experience with DevOps tools (Airflow, Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP), data integration/ETL, and pipeline optimization, or reinforcement learning algorithms
  • Customer collaborator: Comfortable working directly with clients and cross-functional teams, aligning stakeholders, and translating technical concepts into clear business value
  • Entrepreneurial problem-solver: You identify opportunities and risks early, troubleshoot obstacles, and drive creative solutions
  • Continuous learner: You stay current with industry trends, explore new tools/technologies, and thrive in environments that push you to grow
  • Clear communicator: Able to explain complex technical ideas persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $98,000-$164,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $109,000-$183,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we’ve got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching 
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™. Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has been consistently recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was named a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2026. Braze was also named a 2026 Best Places to Work by Built In, a 2025 America’s Greenest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore. 

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

Please see our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.

We’re looking for a Senior Director, Creative to lead and scale our design function as a conceptual, strategic, and operational pillar of the Creative and Brand organization.

This role is responsible not only for visual excellence, but for building, developing, and maintaining a high-performing design team grounded in strong conceptual thinking. Success in this role depends on the ability to set a clear creative bar, move decisively when standards aren’t met, and actively mentor emerging leaders so responsibility and ownership can be pushed downward—freeing this role to operate up, out, and across the organization.

The Senior Director, Creative partners closely with strategy, brand, and creative leadership to ensure our visual systems are insight-led, scalable, and emotionally resonant.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Leadership, Team Building & Talent Development

  • Lead and scale a high-performing, conceptually strong design team spanning brand, motion, and multi-disciplinary creative
  • Build teams intentionally—prioritizing conceptual thinking, taste, and strategic fluency, not just executional skill
  • Establish and uphold a clear, non-negotiable quality bar for design, craft, and thinking
  • Act decisively when performance does not meet expectations—making changes quickly, thoughtfully, and in service of the team’s long-term health
  • Mentor and develop junior leaders so they are prepared to take on delegated ownership, responsibilities, and team leadership
  • Push leadership downward, enabling designers and emerging leads to operate with confidence and autonomy
  • Create clear growth paths, expectations, and feedback mechanisms for all levels of the team

Systems, Process & Operational Scale

  • Design and implement repeatable design systems, workflows, and processes that allow the team to deliver consistently high-quality work at scale
  • Identify inefficiencies in briefing, reviews, production, and delivery—and proactively solve for them
  • Partner with Creative Ops and Marketing Ops to ensure design processes scale with organizational growth
  • Build templates, frameworks, and visual systems that reduce friction and increase speed without compromising quality
  • Balance craft excellence with operational rigor, making “great work, done efficiently” the standard

Strategic & Conceptual Leadership

  • Partner deeply with the strategy function within the Creative and Brand team to ensure design is rooted in clear strategic intent
  • Translate insights, positioning, and brand frameworks into compelling, scalable visual systems
  • Pressure-test strategy through a design lens—helping refine ideas into clear, emotionally resonant expressions
  • Ensure design work ladders back to brand and business objectives, not just aesthetic goals
  • Champion conceptual thinking across the design team, ensuring ideas drive visuals—not the other way around

Strategy Partnership & Integration

  • Act as a creative counterpart to strategy leadership, collaborating early to shape creative direction and success criteria
  • Ensure the design team operates from shared strategic frameworks, not isolated project briefs
  • Help codify the strategy into clear visual guidance that enables faster, more confident execution
  • Establish strong working rhythms with strategy partners through working sessions, reviews, and planning checkpoints
  • Proactively surface and resolve misalignment between strategy and execution

Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership

  • Operate upward by partnering with senior leadership and executives to align design strategy with business priorities
  • Operate across marketing by building trusted relationships with Brand, Product Marketing, Demand, Events, Content, and Comms teams
  • Serve as the final decision-maker on visual direction for the brand
  • Anticipate cross-functional needs and creative risks before they arise—and build processes to address them
  • Represent the design function as a strategic partner, not just a service function

Creative Oversight & Craft

  • Own and evolve the visual identity and design systems for the brand across all touchpoints
  • Provide creative direction across:
    • Brand and campaign design
    • Website and digital experiences
    • Event and experiential marketing
    • Paid media, OOH, and motion
    • Internal-facing brand materials and presentations
  • Partner closely with motion designers to integrate movement into the brand system
  • Oversee freelancers, vendors, and production partners to ensure consistency and quality
  • Step into hands-on design selectively when strategic or conceptual leadership is required

WHO YOU ARE

  • 15+ years of professional design experience, with senior leadership responsibility
  • 5+ years of people management experience, including building and evolving teams
  • Proven ability to build conceptually strong, high-performing creative teams
  • Strong strategic thinker who connects design decisions to brand and business outcomes
  • Comfortable making difficult people decisions in the service of quality and scale
  • Experienced in both agency and client-side environments
  • Deep expertise across design tools and systems (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, motion fundamentals)
  • Confident partnering with developers, strategists, and senior stakeholders

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • The design team consistently delivers conceptually strong, visually compelling work at scale
  • Clear systems exist for how design work is conceived, executed, reviewed, and delivered
  • Junior leaders are growing into meaningful ownership roles, reducing dependency on senior leadership
  • Performance issues are addressed quickly and constructively
  • Strategy and design are tightly integrated, with fewer downstream misalignments
  • Cross-functional partners view design as a strategic thought partner, not just an execution arm
  • The brand feels cohesive, intentional, and emotionally resonant across every touchpoint
  • You are not waiting for guidance/direction, but proactively bringing solutions based on your deep knowledge of the business and partners

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

What You'll Do

The Partner Sales function is the commercial engine connecting Braze's global partner ecosystem - spanning Delivery, Technology, Marketplace, and Channel partners - to the Revenue organization. Partnerships has been named a core strategic pillar by Braze leadership, and the commercial case is clear: partner-influenced deals close at a significant multiple of the rate and deal size of direct-only deals. The AVP, Partner Sales owns making that true globally.

This is a new role at Braze and a genuine opportunity to define what global Partner Sales leadership looks like here. You will sit between the VP, Partnerships and three regional Director-level leaders - covering AMER, EMEA, and APJ - and be accountable for a single global partner revenue number. You will set the strategy, build the operating model, and hold three experienced regional leaders accountable to it. You will also carry the executive relationship layer with Braze's most strategic global partners and represent Partner Sales at VP and C-suite level, both internally and externally.

Responsibilities

  • Own the global Partner Sales function: set strategy, build the operating model, and hold three regional Directors accountable to a consistent global approach across AMER, EMEA, and APJ
  • Lead, develop, and performance-manage three Director and Senior Director-level direct reports, each managing their own regional teams of Partner Sales Managers - total team of approximately 15
  • Own global partner-influenced and partner-sourced revenue targets, consolidating regional performance into a single view for the VP, Partnerships and CRO office
  • Define and implement a consistent global partner coverage framework: territory-to-partner mapping methodology, rules of engagement with Sales, and PQL qualification standards across all regions
  • Drive the partner-first field motion at VP and CRO level - shaping how Revenue leadership thinks about the partner motion, not just enabling the field
  • Own and govern partner attach rates on new business globally, directly enabling the company objective of having 80% of new business onboarded by delivery partners
  • Carry executive relationships with Braze's most strategic global partners - including Deloitte, Accenture, WPP, Publicis, Merkle, AWS, and Google Cloud - at VP and C-suite level, including joint business planning and executive QBRs
  • Partner directly with VP, Partnerships, the CRO office, and Sales AVP leadership to embed partner-first selling as a structural part of the Revenue org
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Partner Experience, Partner Services, Partner Marketing, and GTM Operations to ensure the partner commercial motion is supported by a coherent global ecosystem strategy
  • Travel regularly across AMER, EMEA, and APJ to maintain regional presence, build partner relationships, and support regional Sales leadership engagement

Who You Are

  • 10+ years in partner sales, alliances, or channel sales in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years at Director level or above managing other managers - not just individual contributors
  • Demonstrated experience owning a multi-regional or global partner sales function: you can speak clearly to how you set strategy across markets at different maturity levels and how you held regional leaders accountable to it
  • Track record of influencing VP and C-suite level decisions in a Sales organization - you have shaped how a CRO or Sales VP thinks about the partner motion, not just earned trust with AEs and Sales Directors
  • Deep familiarity with all major partner types - SI/Delivery, Technology/ISV, cloud hyperscalers, and agency/holding company partners - at an executive relationship level, not just an operational one
  • Experience building or significantly redesigning a Partner Sales operating model, including coverage frameworks, rules of engagement with Sales, and performance management for regional Directors
  • Strong understanding of the MarTech ecosystem and how Braze sits within a composable customer engagement stack; you can speak credibly to both technical and commercial partner audiences
  • Leader of leaders - you know how to develop, challenge, and hold accountable Directors who are themselves experienced, tenured, and have strong opinions about their markets
  • Global strategist - you think at function level, not territory level; you can set a coherent global Partner Sales strategy that accounts for regional differences without becoming regionally inconsistent
  • Organizationally influential - you can shape how a revenue organization thinks about partners without a direct reporting line, and you have done it before
  • Executive gravitas - you operate credibly at VP and C-suite level both internally and externally; this is not a role that stops at Director-level relationships
  • Accountable - you own the global number and build a culture of ownership in the leaders beneath you
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and building structure where it doesn't yet exist - Braze is a fast-growing company and this is a brand new function; someone who needs a fully settled environment won't succeed here
  • Comfortable with significant global travel as a core part of the role

jobDescription.title: Account Executive, Scale
jobDescription.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years experience selling, renewing and expanding SaaS solutions to clients in a variety of different verticals in the mid-market, commercial or enterprise segment. Ideally, this experience will include collaboration with Customer Success, Business Development, and Marketing teams’ into the lead generation process.

You will work with Braze’s high growth potential clients to ensure they are maximizing value from technology and services in order to develop and grow the relationship. This is an opportunity to bring your skills as a consultant, business analyst, project manager and sales professional to work with leading brands and expand your knowledge of cross-channel consumer engagement, mobile marketing automation, APIs, analytics and AI Decisioning.

This is a field sales role that routinely requires travel for onsite customer engagement, resulting in a majority of time spent out of the office meeting with and selling to existing customers. Your focus market (although not limited to) will be the Hong Kong and Taiwan market. Fluency in cantonese and mandarin will be considered.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 5+ years of experience in a relevant closing role
  • Background in SaaS sales for Mobile and/or Marketing Technology
  • Up-to-date on digital trends, especially in the AI, mobile, web and Customer Engagement space
  • Intimate knowledge of the Hong Kong and Taiwan technology landscape and network
  • Outstanding verbal, written and stand-up presentation skills, with experience of presenting value propositions to executive teams and at customer/prospect/partner events
  • Proven ability to prospect into target accounts
  • The ability to handle multiple competing priorities
  • A hunter mentality
  • Drive, determination and accountability
  • Excellent organizational skills and time management abilities
  • Proven success navigating organizations and the ability to quickly identify decision makers and the decision-making process for organizations
  • Prior experience with salesforce.com CRM, or other CRM used to manage sales pipeline
  • Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Google Workspace suite of productivity tools and Claude/Gemini
  • Proven ability to quickly get up to speed on new cloud apps and tools

CORE OBJECTIVES

  • Achieve quarterly net new and retention revenue targets
  • Consistently generate robust pipeline in support of these targets
  • Develop commercial relationships in order to increase Braze utilization and value
  • Effectively communicate customer feedback to the Braze product and leadership team.
  • Cross-department collaboration, including but not limited to Business Development, Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Legal and Marketing
  • Coordinate resources to drive feature adoption
  • Excellent Product knowledge
  • Pro-actively analyze customer product usage and identify growth opportunities
  • Work with Success & Onboarding managers and other technical partners to seamlessly transition clients from pre-sales, through onboarding and into ongoing Service usage

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we’ve got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching 
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™. Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has been consistently recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was named a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2026. Braze was also named a 2026 Best Places to Work by Built In, a 2025 America’s Greenest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore. 

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

battery-coram-ai:ashbyhq:91b7e27d-2a6d-4.title: Sales Manager
battery-coram-ai:ashbyhq:91b7e27d-2a6d-4.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.



You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.



The role:

As the Sales Manager, you’ll build and develop the team the culture, and GTM strategy. You’ll hire and coach Account Executives selling across the U.S. and Canada, set the standard for performance, and close strategic deals alongside your team. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll act as a builder and a mentor.



Responsibilities:

 - Successfully hire, train, and coach full-cycle Account Executives

 - Drive sales growth by hitting revenue targets and growing pipeline across all territories

 - Lead by example by maintaining a book of strategic accounts

 - Keep a high bar for culture and standards by defining what winning looks like in every step of the sales cycle

 - Work closely with Executive Leadership, Marketing, and Product to shape GTM strategy

 - Create scalable and repeatable processes, from forecasting to deal execution and performance management



Skills and qualifications:

 - 4+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 2 years managing high-performing teams

 - Proven success building or scaling sales teams in high-growth environments

 - Proven track record of above-target performance and commitment in previous roles

 - Experience selling SaaS, security, or enterprise technology to a highly technical audience

 - Comfortable leading a team selling to national and Canadian accounts

 - Hands-on, results-driven, obsessed with execution and coaching

 - Proficiency with ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and HubSpot

 - Resilient in challenging and fast-paced environments

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence at all levels

 - Ability to work in an onsite environment



What we offer:

 - Competitive compensation package (base salary + variable compensation)

 - 100% Employer-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance

 - Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays

 - 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options

 - Early-stage equity in a rapidly growing company

 - Referral bonuses

 - Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off-sites

 - The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)

We're on a mission to transform a $50B+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.



Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

battery-freehand:ashbyhq:2435c82b-7200-4.title: Head - Digital Marketing
battery-freehand:ashbyhq:2435c82b-7200-4.description:
HEAD - DIGITAL MARKETING

Freehand is building AI Teams that replace staff and software across enterprise supply chain, procurement, and ops finance. Our customers include Meta, GE, Apple, Pfizer, J&J, Cardinal Health, and Unilever. We are recognized by Gartner, Deloitte, McKinsey, and PwC. The product is real, the category is real, and the sales motion is working.

What we have not yet built is a digital marketing engine that matches the ambition of the product. That is what this role is.

There is no team to inherit. No existing playbook to execute. No hand-off deck. You will be the first dedicated digital marketing hire, and you will build — from the ground up — the infrastructure, strategy, and programs that drive awareness, pipeline, and market presence for Freehand across the segments we serve.

If that sounds like a burden, this role is not for you. If it sounds like an opportunity, read on.



THE ROLE

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will own Freehand's entire digital marketing surface — paid, organic, and everything in between — and use it to open new market segments, generate qualified pipeline for the sales team, and establish Freehand's voice in a category that is still being defined.

You will have real autonomy and real budget. You will also be accountable to real outcomes — pipeline contribution, cost per qualified opportunity, organic share of voice, and category-level search presence.

You will work closely with the founders, the sales org, and the product team. There is no layer of approvals between you and the work.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will build and run Freehand's paid performance marketing programs across Google, LinkedIn, and Meta — from strategy and audience architecture to creative briefing, bidding, and ongoing optimization. You will know which lever to pull and when, and you will manage spend with the discipline of someone accountable to CAC, not just impressions.

You will own organic search end to end. That means technical SEO, content strategy mapped to buyer intent across supply chain and procurement personas, keyword architecture, and the editorial calendar that feeds it. You understand how Google reads a page and how a VP of Procurement searches for solutions to a problem.

You will develop and execute an SEM strategy that captures demand at the bottom of the funnel while simultaneously building awareness at the top. You understand the difference between the two and how to budget for both.

You will identify and open new market segments through digital — whether that is a new spend category (MRO, direct materials, services), a new buyer persona (ops finance, logistics), or a new vertical where Freehand has signal but no presence yet. You will design the campaigns, test the hypotheses, and scale what works.

You will build the attribution and measurement infrastructure to know what is actually driving pipeline. You will own the reporting and make decisions based on data, not intuition.

You will create or direct the creation of content — landing pages, ad copy, thought leadership, email sequences — that speaks to senior supply chain and procurement leaders. You can write with authority on a domain you have learned deeply, or you know exactly how to brief someone who can.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have 6+ years of digital marketing experience, with a clear track record in performance marketing — managing significant paid budgets across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Meta Ads Manager, not just observing them.

You have built organic search programs that moved the needle on rankings and inbound traffic, not just written SEO reports. You understand technical SEO as well as content SEO.

You have experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. You know what it means to sell to a VP or C-suite buyer, and you build campaigns accordingly. Supply chain, procurement, or logistics adjacency is a genuine advantage — the closer you have been to this domain, the faster you will ramp.

You have operated as a solo practitioner or lean-team lead before. You are not waiting for a creative director, a content team, or a dedicated analyst. You are the strategist and the executor, and you are comfortable being both.

You are obsessed with measurement. You instrument everything, you know how to set up clean attribution, and you do not report on metrics that do not connect to revenue.

You think in market segments and buyer journeys, not just campaigns. You understand that opening a new segment requires a different motion than capturing existing demand, and you know how to design for both.

You move fast. You ship a test, read the data, and iterate — without needing consensus on every decision.



WHAT THIS IS NOT

This is not a role for someone who has managed agencies, reviewed dashboards, and called it performance marketing. We need someone who has been in the accounts — writing the ad copy, adjusting the bids, restructuring the audience segments, debugging the tracking — and can show the outcomes.

It is also not a role for someone who needs a large team to do meaningful work. The autonomy here is real. So is the expectation that you will figure things out, build infrastructure from scratch, and create leverage for a sales team that is already winning.

Freehand is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the customers and industries we serve.

battery-sisense:greenhouse:7814779.description:
Sisense is the leading AI-powered analytics platform that helps software companies and product teams build smarter, embedded analytics experiences directly into their applications. With Sisense Intelligence - our suite of agentic AI capabilities - we empower application builders to deliver governed conversational analytics, accelerate development with natural language tools, and turn data into actionable insights and revenue.

We're investing heavily in the foundational platform that powers this vision and are looking for a sharp, technical Product Manager to help shape the next generation of our Data & Analytics Platform. You'll drive the core infrastructure, APIs, developer tools, and AI-enablement capabilities that make Sisense the most flexible and powerful choice for embedding intelligence at scale.

We are looking for…

The Sisense Product Team is seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager with a deep passion for platform products, data systems, developer experience, and AI-powered analytics.

This role suits someone who thrives working hand-in-hand with engineering teams, dives deep into technical architecture, and excels at turning complex platform challenges into clear, customer-focused product direction. You will own critical platform foundations that enable application builders to create scalable, secure, composable, and intelligent analytics experiences - from low-code/no-code tools to pro-code extensibility.

We're looking for a curious, analytical, and hands-on PM who is excited by deeply technical areas: infrastructure, platform services, data modeling, APIs, developer SDKs, AI integration, and the capabilities that power modern embedded analytics.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Solutions Engineering, Software Engineering, or a similar role, with a strong technical foundation.
  • Experience with platform products, developer tools, APIs, data platforms, infrastructure, embedded analytics, or AI/ML technologies is a strong advantage.
  • Solid technical understanding and comfort engaging in discussions on architecture, system design, scalability, reliability, APIs, data modeling, and technical trade-offs.
  • Ability to break down complex technical concepts into clear product requirements, user stories, prioritization frameworks, and actionable roadmaps.
  • Excellent English communication skills; ability to collaborate effectively with technical (engineering, architecture) and non-technical (go-to-market, customers) stakeholders.
  • Customer-obsessed mindset, with a talent for deeply understanding the needs of application builders, developers, and end-users, then translating them into high-impact platform solutions.
  • Hands-on and detail-oriented, with a natural tendency to ask “why,” challenge assumptions, and relentlessly validate that delivered capabilities solve real problems.
  • Comfortable working side-by-side with engineers on feature design, technical dependencies, implementation trade-offs, and connecting platform work to measurable customer and business value.
  • Proven ability to lead product capabilities end-to-end: from discovery and validation through delivery, launch, and adoption.
  • Strong prioritization and execution skills in a complex, cross-functional environment; bias for action and ownership.
  • Experience working with AI technologies, LLMs, agentic systems, or shipping AI-powered capabilities is a significant advantage.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own and drive key components of the Sisense Platform, focusing on foundational technical capabilities, infrastructure, APIs, data services, and developer-facing tools that power Sisense Intelligence and embedded experiences.
  • Define clear product requirements for platform services, Compose SDK, MCP connectivity, AI integration layers, internal infrastructure, and extensibility features; drive them from discovery to launch and post-launch optimization.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, and Design teams to make smart, balanced product and technical decisions that balance speed, scalability, reliability, and innovation.
  • Collaborate with customers, product leaders, and go-to-market teams to uncover needs, validate problems, and prioritize platform investments that deliver maximum impact for application builders.
  • Work with other PMs to ensure seamless end-to-end experiences that let developers and product teams leverage the full power of Sisense’s AI-driven analytics engine.
  • Prioritize backlog based on customer value, technical strategy, scalability, security, developer experience, and long-term platform health.
  • Communicate roadmap, strategy, and decisions transparently to stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
  • Create high-quality internal and external documentation, presentations, and enablement materials that clearly articulate the value and usage of platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to and help evolve Sisense’s overall platform strategy, ensuring it remains scalable, extensible, secure, AI-native, and developer-friendly.

Why you should join our team

Sisense is redefining embedded analytics by moving far beyond traditional dashboards. We deliver a full-stack Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that combines powerful data modeling, composable embedding tools, and Sisense Intelligence - our agentic AI suite (including Assistant, Managed LLM, and MCP server) - to help application builders prototype faster, embed conversational analytics, and deliver governed, actionable insights directly inside their products.

In this role, you'll tackle challenging technical problems at the heart of the platform, influence foundational decisions that impact thousands of developers and end-users, and work alongside talented teams across Product, Engineering, Design, and Go-to-Market. If you’re passionate about platform thinking, technical depth, AI enablement, and building the infrastructure that powers other great products, this is your chance to make a significant impact in a fast-evolving space.

bcapital-arta-finance:ashbyhq:742f24b3-8.title: Recruiting Operations Coordinator (Contractor)
bcapital-arta-finance:ashbyhq:742f24b3-8.description:
THE COMPANY

Arta Finance is an AI-powered wealth platform on a mission to help people lead more successful financial lives. We combine intelligent technology, sophisticated investment capabilities, and exceptional user experiences to deliver wealth management solutions traditionally available only to the ultra-wealthy.

We're building a team of ambitious, curious, and collaborative individuals who are excited to tackle challenging problems and create meaningful impact.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiting Operations Coordinator (Contractor) to support our growing hiring efforts across engineering, product, design, operations, and business functions.

In this role, you will serve as a key operational partner to our hiring managers, recruiting agencies, interviewers, and candidates. You will help ensure a seamless recruiting process by coordinating interviews, managing candidate logistics, facilitating communication across stakeholders, and driving recruiting operations with accuracy and attention to detail.

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys managing multiple priorities simultaneously, and takes pride in creating exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences.




WHAT YOU WILL DO


RECRUITING AGENCY & HIRING MANAGER COORDINATION

 - Serve as the primary point of contact between Arta hiring managers and external recruiting agencies

 - Facilitate communication regarding open roles, candidate submissions, interview feedback, and hiring decisions

 - Ensure agency partners have timely updates on candidate status and process changes

 - Track agency performance, candidate pipelines, and recruiting activity across active searches

 - Help maintain strong working relationships with recruiting partners while ensuring a high-quality candidate experience


INTERVIEW SCHEDULING & CANDIDATE LOGISTICS

 - Coordinate phone screens, virtual and onsite interviews, and executive interviews across multiple time zones

 - Be present in the office 4~5 days a week. For the onsite interviews, register candidates with the building reception, escort them to the meeting room.

 - Ensure a smooth and professional experience throughout the interview process

 - Quickly resolve scheduling conflicts and last-minute changes


CANDIDATE & PIPELINE MANAGEMENT

 - Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting data within the Applicant Tracking System (Ashby)

 - Track interview completion, feedback collection, and hiring team responsiveness

 - Assist with candidate communications, including interview invitations, status updates, and offer coordination


OFFER & HIRING SUPPORT

 - Assist with offer logistics and candidate closing activities in collaboration with the hiring managers, who will directly communicate the offer details with candidates

 - Coordinate offer letters for signing, and transition to the Office Manager for the onboarding handoffs

 - Support ad hoc recruiting projects and hiring initiatives as the company scales




WHO YOU ARE

 - Minimum 3 years of recruiting coordination experience within a technology company, high-growth startup, or fast-paced recruiting environment

 - Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (Ashby preferred) and scheduling tools

 - Demonstrated experience supporting multiple concurrent hiring processes and stakeholders

 - Strong experience coordinating interviews across multiple time zones and seniority levels

 - Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail

 - Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and responsiveness

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Strong stakeholder management skills and a customer-service mindset

 - Comfortable working independently in a dynamic, fast-moving environment




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience supporting technical recruiting teams

 - Experience working with external recruiting agencies and search firms

 - Experience supporting global hiring across North America, APAC, and EMEA

 - Familiarity with recruiting metrics, reporting, and process optimization

 - Previous experience in fintech, AI, SaaS, or other high-growth technology companies
